deployRegistry.notes: Single shared registry for all identities (deployed once per network).

createIdentity.notes: Identity exists implicitly (every address is a DID, zero-cost). Measured: first setAttribute publishing a verification key.

updateAttribute.notes: setAttribute rotating the published key (event-only storage; DID document built off-chain from event history).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: addDelegate(veriKey) with 1-year validity. On-chain claims are not part of ERC-1056.

revoke.notes: revokeAttribute of the published key. revokeDelegate is also supported at similar cost.

transferOwnership.notes: changeOwner: rotates the controlling key of the DID (identifier itself is stable).

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared NFT contract; deployer receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANUFACTURER_ROLE in constructor.

createIdentity.notes: mintVehicle (manufacturer-only): mints NFT, stores VIN mapping + on-chain metadata struct + initial transfer record.

updateAttribute.notes: No key/attribute model in ERC-721. Measured closest analogue: addServiceRecord appending a metadata URI (role grant excluded as setup).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: approve(): delegates TRANSFER rights only - not a verification-key delegation or identity claim as in DID standards.

transferOwnership.notes: transferFrom: token transfer with on-chain transfer-history bookkeeping (contract overrides _update).

revoke.notes: deactivateVehicle (admin-only): marks identity inactive; token itself is not burned.

deployRegistry.notes: No shared registry in ERC-725: each identity is its own proxy-account contract. Deployment cost is counted under createIdentity.

createIdentity.notes: Per-vehicle identity contract deployment (proxy account); deployer becomes owner/management key. Paid once per identity.

updateAttribute.notes: addKey(purpose=1 MANAGEMENT, type=1 ECDSA): key rotation/addition stored in contract state.

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: addKey(purpose=3 CLAIM signer key). Full on-chain claims require the companion ERC-735 contract (not yet implemented).

revoke.notes: removeKey: deletes key and compacts the key array (cost grows with number of stored keys).

transferOwnership.notes: transferOwnership of the identity contract to the new vehicle owner.

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared registry (V2 = ERC-1056 base + MOBI VID I birth certificates + VID II lifecycle events); deployer becomes registry authority + authorized manufacturer.

createIdentity.notes: registerVehicleBirth (MOBI VID I birth certificate): VIN hash + encrypted VIN + cert hash + first owner. birthAttributes left empty to avoid known V1 validity-overflow bug.

updateAttribute.notes: recordLifecycleEvent (MOBI VID II, MAINTENANCE): stores full event struct + VC hash + counters on-chain. Issuer authorization excluded as setup.

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: Inherited ERC-1056 addDelegate (sigAuth, 1 year). V2-native multi-party attestEvent (claim analogue, 65-byte signature stored) measured separately: 188446 gas.

transferOwnership.notes: transferVehicleOwnership: appends odometer-stamped ownership record + ERC-1056 changeOwner. Called by current owner.

revoke.notes: revokeIdentity (inherited ERC-1056 extension): permanently flags the vehicle DID as revoked (decommissioning).

metadata.notes: gasUsed is the exact receipt.gasUsed of a single representative transaction per operation on a fresh Hardhat in-process network. null = operation not supported by the standard (see notes). Setup transactions (role grants, issuer authorization) are excluded from operation gas.
